test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A train ran for 12 km in the north direction from Point A to reach Point B. From there, it took a right turn and ran for 20 km to reach Point C. Then, it ran for 6 km after taking a left turn and reached Point D. From there, it took a left turn again and ran for a distance of 8 km to reach Point E. Then, it covered 18 km in the south direction to reach Point F. 

How far and in which direction is Point A with respect to Point F?
solution:
According to given conditions, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85a9683f12e29f08815569ae40d241990c0384118b21c8c55c7b94079168506f.png] 

Clearly, point A is 12 km to the West of point F.

Hence, ‘**12 km, west**’ is the correct answer.
